page.overview:
Who is Wreckage?

Wreckage was once a soldier in the army. After one mission his status became M.I.A. but he was actually captured and subjected to cybernetic experimentation.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2| G.I. Joe Extreme

Version 1 of Wreckage was planned for release as a basic figure in the G.I. Joe Extreme line in 1996. Ultimately, He was not produced. He (along with planned Rampage and Mayday figures) can be seen on the back of the packaging for Black Dragon and Harpoon. ---- Appearance:

---- [https://www.yojoe.com/action/other/extreme/unproduced/figures.shtml YoJoe.com page]
